test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Among six students, K, L, M, N, O and P, each scores different marks in an examination. M scores more marks than only three other students. K scores more marks than N. P scores less marks than M. O scores more marks than L. P scores more marks than K. L scores more marks than M. Who scores the highest marks among all six students?
solution:
**Given: **Six students, K, L, M, N, O and P.

1. M scores more marks than only three other students.

2) L scores more marks than M.

3) O scores more marks than L.

O > L > M > ___ >___ >___

4. K scores more marks than N.

5. P scores more marks than K.

P > K > N

6. P scores less marks than M.

O > L > M > P > K > N

Here, the highest mark scored among all six students is **'O'**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (2).**
